description: This file defines an interface 'NiaNetworkDataSource' that specifies network call methods for fetching topics, news resources, and change lists from the NIA backend service.

classes.name: NiaNetworkDataSource
classes.description: Interface specifying network data access methods such as fetching topics, news resources, and change lists from the NIA backend.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of NetworkTopic objects, optionally filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of NetworkNewsResource objects, optionally filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of NetworkChangeList objects representing topic changes after a specified point.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of NetworkChangeList objects representing news resource changes after a specified point.
